GOOD TO KNOW

Questions, Answered

Rooms are blocked at the venue hotel and nearby hotels at special wedding rates. Mention “Ayaan–Mahira Wedding” while booking.

Nearest Airport?

Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad — about 30 minutes from the venue.

Where Should We Stay?

Rooms are blocked at the venue hotel and nearby hotels at special wedding rates. Mention “Ayaan–Mahira Wedding” while booking.

Transport & Parking

Shuttle service from partner hotels every 30 minutes on 30 November. Valet parking is available at the venue.

Are Children Invited?

Absolutely! Children are the joy of a wedding. A play zone and a special menu will be arranged.

Contact For Help
